decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The erection of a single storey side extension and erection of bin store area to the front of the existing house, as shown on drawing numbers 03 dated 27.04.2006  (Amended plans) received 28 April 2006, would by reason of its size and position, satisfactorily maintain the existing street scene and amenity of neighbours and also preserve and enhance the appearance and character of Chiswick House Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 5 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of single storey side extension and erection of bin store area to the front of house
